$description: SankeyDiagram (platform/charts/SankeyDiagram.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. Nodes are the frame's marks (chart-*); a band is its source's data color at an opacity of the theme's scale; names and totals are labels with a halo. No new color: existing roles.

sankey-diagram-link-opacity.$description: Sankey diagram: a band's opacity at rest, so the bands' crossings stay visible.

sankey-diagram-link-active-opacity.$description: Sankey diagram: a band's opacity when it, or a node it joins, is under the pointer.

sankey-diagram-label-font-family.$description: Sankey diagram: node names are UI text: the label font.

sankey-diagram-label-font-size.$description: Sankey diagram: a node's name's size.

sankey-diagram-label-font-weight.$description: Sankey diagram: a node's name's weight.

sankey-diagram-label-offset.$description: Sankey diagram: the distance between a node and its name (after it; before it in the last column).

sankey-diagram-label-halo-color.$description: Sankey diagram: the halo under a name and total, in the surface color, so they read over the bands.

sankey-diagram-value-text.$description: Sankey diagram: a node's total after its name.

sankey-diagram-value-font-family.$description: Sankey diagram: totals are technical values: the data font (DM Mono).
